name: Membership Lifecycle
description: Full membership lifecycle: invite, accept, decline, promote, demote, suspend, remove. Every transition is receipted and auditable. Invitations expire on a configurable timer.
purpose: Ensure membership transitions are always traceable, non-repudiable, and reversible according to policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Invite flow: create invitation with expiry, target principal, role
Accept flow: principal signs acceptance receipt
Decline flow: invitation marked declined, no effect on membership
Promote and demote flows with role transition receipts
Suspend flow: member suspended with reason, capabilities suspended
Remove flow: member removed with cascading cleanup of memberships
Every transition produces a receipt with actor, target, timestamp, transition type
